title: 第9章 我穿越的不是古代嘛第10章 心猿
content_zh:
李青山还是第一次来县城，颇有新鲜感。
远远看着，只能看到连绵不绝的城墙，还有城墙外，一眼看不到尽头的田地。
走得近了，排在进城队伍中，李青山才有些吃惊。
这县城的城墙，未免过于高大雄伟了。
他前世是去首都看过故宫的。
但和眼前的城墙相比，不过是小巫见大巫。
“是不是很震撼？”
李铁见李青山面露惊色，嘿嘿一笑。
李青山收回目光，疑惑道：“铁哥，这么高的城墙，是为了防谁？”
闻言，李铁愣了愣，摇摇头：“这我怎么知道，只知道县城存在很久很久了，在铁腿门来这边之前就有。”
边上一骑马的路人听到两人对话，又看了眼他们的穿着，面露不屑：
“真是两只井底之蛙。
不过是十丈高的城墙罢了。
我们清远县城内居住人口不过十余万，才这般寒酸。
听去府城游历的人说，府城的城墙，动不动高达百丈，站在城墙上，看人如蚂蚁。
那才是真正的雄伟...”
被人鄙夷，李铁却自然而然地露出谄媚笑容，奉承道：“公子好见识，一看就出身不凡。”
骑马路人笑着摆摆手，没有多言。
他要是真出身不凡，就直接从小城门进去了，还用在这排队？
不过别人说话好听，他自然不会开口反驳。

...
进了城。
李铁解释道：“青山，出门在外，安全第一，脸面这东西，最不值钱，用不着为那种人生闷气。”
李青山敷衍地点点头，打量着街道两旁的建筑。
他对清远县城的第一印象，就是大。
不仅是城墙高大的过分，连里面的建筑也是如此。
并且这些建筑大多整齐划一，好似一个模子复制粘贴而成。
街道也宽阔的不行。
行人、小贩、往来马车、拉着各种物资的板车...全部塞在一条街道上，还是显得空旷。
他简单目测了下。
街道两边，怕是有三十多米的距离。
别说跑马车了。
直接跑火车都轻轻松松。
布局就挺不合理的。
而且城里马匹的数量也有些过多了。
content_en:
It was Li Qingshan's first time coming to the county, so it was quite new.
Looking from a distance, you can only see the endless city walls, and the endless fields outside the city walls.
Li Qingshan was a little surprised when he got closer and was in the queue entering the city.
The city wall of this county town is too tall and majestic.
In his previous life, he went to the capital to see the Forbidden City.
But compared with the city wall in front of me, it was nothing but a big deal.
"Isn't it shocking?"
Li Tie chuckled when he saw Li Qingshan's expression of shock.
Li Qingshan looked away and asked doubtfully: "Brother Tie, who are these high walls for defense?"
Hearing this, Li Tie was stunned and shook his head: "How do I know this? I only know that the county has existed for a long time, before the Iron Leg Gate came here."
A passerby on horseback heard the conversation between the two and took a look at their clothes with disdain on his face:
"What two frogs in a well.
It's just a city wall ten feet high.
Our Qingyuan County has a population of only more than 100,000, which is why it is so shabby.
People who have traveled to Fucheng say that the walls of Fucheng are often as high as a hundred feet high. Standing on the wall, people look like ants.
That is the true majesty..."
Although he was looked down upon by others, Li Tie naturally showed a flattering smile and said flatteringly: "Young Master is very knowledgeable, and you can tell he is from an extraordinary family at a glance."
The passerby on horseback smiled and waved his hands without saying anything.
If he was really of extraordinary origin, he would have entered directly from the small city gate, and why would he still have to queue here?
However, if others speak nicely, he will naturally not refute.
...
Entered the city.
Li Tie explained: "Qingshan, when you go out, safety comes first. Face is the most worthless thing. There is no need to sulk about that kind of life."
Li Qingshan nodded perfunctorily and looked at the buildings on both sides of the street.
His first impression of Qingyuan County was that it was big.
Not only are the walls too tall, but so are the buildings inside.
And most of these buildings are uniform, as if they were copied and pasted from the same mold.
The streets are also extremely wide.
Pedestrians, vendors, horse-drawn carriages, and carts pulling various supplies...all crowded together on one street, but it still seemed empty.
He made a simple visual inspection.
There is probably a distance of more than thirty meters on both sides of the street.
Forget about running a carriage.
It's easy to just take the train.
The layout is quite unreasonable.
And there are too many horses in the city.
